title: A2 Milestone 3: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has superado el Tercer Hito del Nivel A2. Estás cada vez más cerca del nivel Intermedio (B1).

parts.visual: En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 21 a 29: Entrevistas (Tell me about yourself, achievement), Segundo Condicional (If I had money, I would buy it), Logística (Supplier, warehouse, shipping).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 21 to 29: Job Interviews, The Second Conditional, and Logistics and Supply Chain.

parts.visual: También evaluaremos: Voz Pasiva Presente (It is cleaned), Presentaciones (Welcome everyone, move on), Viajes de negocios (Boarding pass, expense report), Adverbios (quickly, well, hard), Phrasal Verbs (Set up, call off) y Voz Pasiva Pasado (It was founded).
parts.audio: We will also evaluate: Passive Voice in Present and Past, Giving a presentation, Business travel vocabulary, Adverbs of manner, and Phrasal Verbs.

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador (Lecciones 21-29).

questions.question: Could you ____ me about yourself? (Entrevista).
What is your greatest ____? (Logro).
If I ____ you, I would accept the job. (Segundo Condicional).
questions.explanation: If I were you (Si yo fuera tú).

questions.question: They would buy it if we ____ the price. (Segundo Condicional - Redujéramos).
We order materials from our ____. (Proveedor).
The goods are stored in the ____. (Almacén).
The office ____ cleaned every day. (Voz Pasiva Presente).
English is ____ here. (Participio de speak).
The ____ of my presentation is to show the results. (Propósito).
Let's ____ on to the next slide. (Pasemos).
questions.explanation: Move on to the next slide.

questions.question: I need to print my ____ pass. (Pase de abordar).
Submit your ____ report to HR. (Reporte de gastos).
She works very ____. (Cuidadosamente - Adverbio).
He speaks English very ____. (Bien - Adverbio).
We ____ off the meeting because he was sick. (Cancelamos - Phrasal Verb).
Let's ____ up a new meeting for tomorrow. (Organizar - Phrasal Verb).
The company ____ founded in 1990. (Fue fundada - Pasiva Pasado).
The emails ____ sent yesterday. (Fueron enviados - Pasiva Pasado).
The report was ____ by the manager. (Escrito - Participio).
I look ____ to hearing from you. (Espero con ansias).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Completa el repaso escribiendo la palabra correcta.

questions.question: If I ____ money, I would buy it. (Tuviera - Past Simple de have)
